statements.text: A small bowl of mixed fruit at recess supports healthy eating.
An entire large bag of chips at recess is healthy because fruit is wholesome and chips suit any time.
One brightly coloured candy piece is healthiest because the smallest portion is always best.

stem: Bilal chooses a mid-morning recess snack. He wants a choice that supports healthy eating: wholesome food, a moderate amount, and a suitable time.

teacher.key_rationale: Healthy eating needs wholesome food, moderate quantity, and a suitable time. A huge chip bag and a colour/smallest-portion rule miss that checklist.
